title: Implement Video section variant (video-embed)
description: Implement a Video section that embeds a YouTube or Vimeo video with a headline and optional description.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ content: VideoContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Renders headline, iframe embed with correct aspect ratio (16:9)
videoUrl is converted to embed URL (youtube.com/watch?v=ID → youtube.com/embed/ID)
Optional poster image shown as thumbnail placeholder if videoUrl is not embeddable
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Create `src/components/shared/video/VideoEmbed.tsx`, `index.ts`. Headline + iframe wrapper with `aspect-video` class (16:9). Convert YouTube watch URL to embed URL using string replace: `youtube.com/watch?v=ID` → `youtube.com/embed/ID`. Same for Vimeo: `vimeo.com/ID` → `player.vimeo.com/video/ID`. Allow `allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture'`.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify video iframe renders at correct aspect ratio.
